description: Mint a signed, expiring URL that opens the desktop capsule's LIVE screen in any browser with no login. The person watching sees your pointer, clicks and keys as you act, plus your narration. mode 'control' (default) also lets them take the screen and hand it back; 'view' only watches. Open it in your browser pane or give it to the person.
name: capsulate_console_link
title: Get a live console link
